problem.text: A robot walks from the bottom-left to the top-right corner of a 8 by 4 grid of squares, one unit right or up at a time. How many different routes can it take?
hints: Every route is a string of rights and ups.
Each route has 12 steps: 8 right and 4 up.
Choose which 8 of the 12 steps go right.

claude.think: Routes from (0,0) to (8,4) need 8 rights and 4 ups in some order: C(12,4) = 495.
claude.reasoning: For an 8 by 4 grid, the number of monotonic lattice paths is C(12,4) = 495, so I'll go with that answer confidently.

gpt.think: Each route has 8 right moves and 4 up moves, arranged in 12 steps: choose the 4 positions for the up moves, giving 12 choose 4 = 495.

problem.text: How many whole numbers from 1 to 231 share no common factor with 231 other than 1?
hints: Multiply n by (1 − 1/p) for each prime p that divides it.
